TWO GAMES, THREE PLAYABLES, NO INSTALL

Everything below is a single self-contained HTML file — hand-rolled WebGL, no engine, no build step, no dependencies. Click and it runs.

BONKHORDE

BONKHORDE PLAY
A 3D survivors-like. You never attack — every weapon fires on its own cooldown, and the only verb is positioning. Survive twenty minutes; four bosses and a sudden-death finale disagree.
WASD move · MOUSE camera (drag if pointer lock is unavailable) · SPACE jump  ·  works on a phone: left thumb moves, right thumb turns  ·  ~1,600 lines, 130 automated checks

ESTATE LIQUIDATORS — PROTOTYPES

First-person prototype PLAY
Empty a dead collector's house before sunrise. The quota is in dollars, not items, and something in there is still curating the collection.
WASD move · E grab · F appraise  ·  needs pointer lock, so use a desktop browser
Top-down loop prototype PLAY
The same haul loop from above, with the simulation-verified attention and disturbance models wired in. Built to test the economy, not the feel.
Source and write-ups on GitHub. Both projects document what their own measurements disproved.
